 In The High Court Of Judicature At Patna
 Criminal Miscellaneous No.86340 of 2024
 Arising Out of Ps. Case No.-584 Year-2022 Thana- Khagaria Compalint

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Patna
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
=
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Ranjeet Kumar Singh, Advocate
For the Opposite Party/s : Mrs. Pushpa Sinha.1, APP

== = ==
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE S. B. PD. SINGH  ORAL ORDER 3 09-04-2025 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel appearing on behalf of Opposite Party No. 2.
2.

The petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Complaint Case No. 584C of 2022 for the offence punishable under Sections 494 and 498A of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.

3. As agreed between both the parties, the matter is referred to the Mediation and Conciliation Center, Patna High Court, Patna for exploring the possibility of amicable settlement of their matrimonial dispute.

Petitioner as well as O.P. No. 2 shall appear in person there on 05th of May,
2025.
4. Put up this case under the heading 'For Admission' on 30th of June, 2025 along with the report of Mediation and Conciliation Centre, Patna High Court, Patna.

Patna High Court CR. MISC.
No.86340 of 2024(3) dt.09-04-2025 5.
In the meantime, interim protection granted to the petitioner vide order dated 17.12.2024 shall continue till further order.

(S. B. Pd. Singh, J) Ankit Kumar/-
